title: One prompt refiner: yes or changes?

owner_note.text: Plan: keep PromptRecords on Sonnet, fed by Ask.write; each of the other seven refiners has its lesson written down first, then moves to an archive folder. It costs about $11 to build and about $9 a week to run. This week 0% of your sentences landed in a task on every channel, because PromptTasks is switched off and cloud voice doesn't store your words. Nothing retires or changes until you say yes.
